key_insight: PedDx classifies pediatric posterior fossa tumors from MRI, with higher accuracy among cases retained after confidence-based abstention.
clinical_relevance: This diagnostic AI research—not drug discovery—may inform future imaging-based assessment, but does not establish readiness for clinical use.
method: Uses T2-weighted MRI and pretrained 3DINO representations without tumor segmentation.
Combines calibrated predictions with confidence-based abstention.
Tests external performance, imaging perturbations, and an independently executed agentic workflow.
evidence_signal: Across 492 discovery, 114 replication, 129 external-validation, and 40 independently tested cases, accuracy was 79.8%, 81.4%, and 92.5% in the latter three cohorts, rising to 90.5%, 88.7%, and 97.3% among non-abstained cases.
watch_item: Testing on 236 out-of-distribution cases and controlled imaging perturbations revealed confidently incorrect predictions and acquisition/alignment vulnerabilities; abstention-based accuracy gains exclude some cases.
paper_title: PedDx: An End-to-End Deep Learning Framework for Pediatric Posterior Fossa Tumor Diagnosis with Agentic AI-Enabled Independent External Evaluation
